column1: # The front page in Brazilian Portuguese (/pt-BR/). One row is one sentence of site/src: the English
# sentence exactly as the code writes it, its translation, a status, and a note when the translation
# is not the literal one (why, and the word it follows). The pattern is h0ffmann/h0ffmann#86.
# `just site` fails when a sentence of the page has no row, or a row no sentence (site/content).
# status: draft (an agent wrote it) or reviewed (a native reader read it). An agent never writes reviewed.
